findings.claim: The campaign source fingerprint list omits directly imported source files, so the source-bound receipt can pass with stale or changed executed code.
findings.evidence: CAMPAIGN_INPUT_PATHS hashes 26 paths but does not include files directly imported by the changed campaign code, e.g. replica-mounted.integration.test.ts imports "../session-revocation-events" and replica-mounted-runtime.ts/replica-browser-memory.ts import "./replica-owner"; acceptance criterion Task 5 and the 'Evidence is absent or stale' scenario require matching source/configuration fingerprints and say missing proof must keep the gate open.
findings.suggested_fix: Add every directly executed/imported local source file used by the browser and mounted materializer runs to CAMPAIGN_INPUT_PATHS, including web/src/shared/session-revocation-events.ts and web/src/shared/sync/replica-owner.ts, or replace the hand-maintained list with a dependency graph-derived manifest.
